ticket: Extend the refund window to 30 days.
notes: docs/orders.md already says 30 days, but REFUND_WINDOW_DAYS is 14. A good system notices the doc/code mismatch and asks which is intended and whether existing orders are affected.

criticalAmbiguities.description: Whether the longer window applies to orders already placed.
Docs and code disagree (30 vs 14); which reflects the intended policy.

expectedContradictions.description: docs/orders.md says 30 days; the code uses 14.

unacceptableAssumptions.description: Treating the docs value as the current behavior.
